message.charter.lesser_divinity.offhand: The Lesser Divinity answers only from the off hand.
message.charter.regalia.spared: The chains fall away from the Regalia. The verdict finds nothing to hold.
message.charter.token.spared: The Token of Absolution crumbles. The verdict passes you by.
tooltip.charter.charter_contract.1: Use it on a player who crouches to draw up a contract.
tooltip.charter.charter_contract.2: You become its creator and they become its signer.
tooltip.charter.charter_contract.3: The signer can never harm you.
tooltip.charter.charter_contract.4: Crouch and use it twice to sign with Charter itself.
tooltip.charter.cursed: Bound to %s: nobody else can hold it
tooltip.charter.divine_dominance.1: Used on the ground it raises a pillar of Charter, wrapped in chains.
tooltip.charter.divine_dominance.2: A golden wall rises %s blocks wide, then closes in.
tooltip.charter.divine_dominance.3: Only its owner and the bound may cross.
tooltip.charter.divine_dominance.4: When the walls meet, Charter judges whoever is left.
tooltip.charter.dusk_epitaph.1: A full blow chains the target while the blade
tooltip.charter.dusk_epitaph.2: becomes light and falls: players are banned.
tooltip.charter.dusk_epitaph.3: Every other creature is simply slain.
tooltip.charter.dusk_epitaph.contract: Answers only to those bound to Charter.
tooltip.charter.dusk_epitaph.gated.1: A full blow on someone down to half a heart chains
tooltip.charter.dusk_epitaph.gated.2: them while the blade becomes light and falls: players are banned.
tooltip.charter.dusk_epitaph.spares: It never kills outright: it leaves half a heart.
tooltip.charter.fractured_lesser_divinit: Chains up all in its sigil and casts them out.
The exiled cannot die until they near home.
tooltip.charter.half_heart: Only takes those down to half a heart.
tooltip.charter.lesser_divinity.1: The sigil of Charter chains up those within it.
tooltip.charter.lesser_divinity.2: Then a beam bans them and erases the land.
tooltip.charter.lesser_divinity.3: Off hand only. The last charge destroys it.
tooltip.charter.regalia.1: Wear all four pieces to be beyond Charter's reach.
tooltip.charter.regalia.2: Its golden chains cannot seize you, and no ban, kick or exile can fall on you.
tooltip.charter.regalia.3: Every shackle on it hangs open.
tooltip.charter.sigil_staff.1: Draws a small sigil where you look.
tooltip.charter.sigil_staff.2: Everything inside is chained, then judged.
tooltip.charter.sigil_staff.3: Crouch and use it to change the mode.
tooltip.charter.signed_contract.creator: Drawn up by %s
Strike the signer with a sword in your off hand to take an arm.
Use it with a Charter weapon in your off hand to curse the weapon.
Crouch and use it twice to release the signer.
tooltip.charter.signed_contract.signer.2: Crouch and use it twice to break it. Every break costs a part of your body.
tooltip.charter.token_of_absolution.1: Turns away one verdict of Charter.
tooltip.charter.token_of_absolution.2: Worn as a necklace. When a ban, kick or exile is about to fall on you, the token crumbles instead.
tooltip.charter.token_of_absolution.3: The chains still close. Only the sentence passes you by.
death.attack.charter.crush.item: %1$s was crushed between golden walls by %2$s using %3$s
death.attack.charter.crush.player: %1$s was crushed between golden walls while fighting %2$s
death.attack.charter.judgement.item: %1$s was judged by Charter at the hand of %2$s using %3$s
death.attack.charter.judgement.player: %1$s was judged by Charter while fighting %2$s
